paragraphs: On Friday, the Explorers made food for the school sale in the cooking class. Chef Lucy showed the children how to make strawberry jam and butter cookies. The kitchen smelled sweet and warm. For the jam, they used strawberries and sugar. For the cookies, they used flour, butter, and sugar. Then Leo wrote a price list for the stall.

The sign on the stall said, "Explorers' Sale, Saturday morning." "Butter cookies, ten baht for one bag." "Jam sandwich, fifteen baht." "Strawberry jam, twenty baht for one jar." "We sell all the food for the school library." "We save the money for new books."

The stall opened at nine o'clock. A boy came to the stall and asked, "Is the jam sweet?" "Yes, it is," said Mia. "It has a lot of sugar." A woman asked, "Are the cookies new?" "Yes, they are," said May. "We made them yesterday, and we put butter in each piece." "Is the jam fifteen baht?" asked the woman. "No, it is not," said May. "The jam is twenty baht, and the sandwich is fifteen baht."

The boy bought a jam sandwich and said, "Thank you!" The woman bought a jar of jam and a bag of cookies. Leo gave her the food, and she gave him the money. Then Leo had a problem. He had no more small bags for the cookies. "Use the paper bags from the kitchen," said Chef Lucy. Mia ran to the kitchen and came back with ten bags.

At twelve o'clock, the stall was empty. The children sold all the jam and all the cookies. "Chef Lucy, can we make more next month?" asked May. "Yes, we can," said Chef Lucy with a smile. Leo put the money in a small box for the school library. "This is the best sale in the school!" he said.
